inputs.commit_message: Collect remaining ASOL adversarial failures only
inputs.shell_command:
set -uo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
git fetch --prune origin main
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main || exit 90
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" || exit 91
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 92
failures=0
run_gate() { label="$1"; shift; echo "=== GATE:$label ==="; "$@"; rc=$?; echo "GATE_RESULT:$label:$rc"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi; }

run_gate cors-spoof env ASOL_CORS_ORIGINS=https://trusted.example ./node_modules/.bin/tsx -e "import { NextRequest } from 'next/server'; import { proxy } from './src/proxy'; const req=new NextRequest('https://gova.example/api/products',{method:'OPTIONS',headers:{origin:'https://trusted.example.evil.tld','access-control-request-method':'GET'}}); const res=proxy(req); const reflected=res.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin'); console.log('SPOOF_REFLECTED='+String(reflected)); if (reflected === 'https://trusted.example.evil.tld') { console.error('FATAL_CORS_PREFIX_BYPASS'); process.exit(73); }"
run_gate architecture npm run architecture:check
run_gate docs npm run docs:ci
run_gate verify-all npm run verify:all
run_gate test-all npm run test
run_gate control-sync npm run control:sync
run_gate control-verify npm run control:verify
run_gate control-build npm run control:build
run_gate control-smoke npm run control:smoke

echo "ADVERSARIAL_FAILURE_COUNT=$failures"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" || exit 93
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 94
if [ $failures -ne 0 ]; then exit 95; fi
echo 'ADVERSARIAL_VERIFICATION_3=PASS'
